## HERA — high-density electron Landau fan for the stacking test

> **05:25** · D~0 electron fan; n=2.8..3.2e12 cm^-2 (11); B=1->6 T (221 uniform-1/B rows); 10 nA, 3 s dwell, Si=0; hold 6 T · **ETA ~08:55** (≈3h30m)

Proceed under the recorded E1 grant with `landau-fan-vti`, following `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Steps 2–5. Gates A/B remain green (measure 18/32 and handoff 44/46); Gate C passed in runs 0–3. Runs 6/7 and their raw-first analysis in ana 14–17 establish oscillations but leave harmonic/pocket ambiguity. Electrons reach the model's discriminating density range; the stronger hole signal is limited to |n|≤1.27×10¹² by the committed TG fence and has overlapping tones. Use run-5 region-A calibration (ratio measured, absolute scale geometry-prior, D≈0 inferred from ridge symmetry), and retain the second CNP ridge as a spatial-density uncertainty.

**Resolution and coverage.** The local-window `sdh_onset` audit of run 6 gives 1.003–1.010 T across polynomial degrees 3/5/7; start at 1.00 T, rounding down. Full-record detrending gives a censored onset and is documented as a background-extraction limitation; this fan does not establish sub-1-T absence. The model predicts ABAB tones 6.04/22.91 T at n=2.8 and 7.31/25.78 T at n=3.2, compared with ABCA F_L=28.95–33.09 T. At 6 T the low-density partner has 5.03 periods and δF=1.20 T; if its actual onset rises across density, downgrade the period/absence claim. Use 221 uniform-1/B rows (Δ1/B=0.003788 T⁻¹, Nyquist 132 T) to protect against run 6's observed high-frequency content, plus 11 density points (Δn=0.04×10¹², the ray-Nyquist floor with 20% scale allowance). This is 2431 points. The narrow 2.8–3.2 window includes the spot-check anchor, excludes CNP/holes, and may leave an adjacent-N/ABCB fork if the short branch trajectories cannot distinguish models. CNP-to-3.2 coverage at the same sampling would add ~15,500 points (~15 h including margin) while violating the five-partner-period criterion at low n. Lowering the electron edge to 2.7 requires about 9 T for five partner periods; ≤2.6 cannot meet that criterion below the 10 T cap at this onset.

**Acquisition and price.** Fixed 10 nA drive, sr1=20 µV (2 kΩ nominal full scale), sr0=20 mV, inherited τ=0.3 s / 24 dB, point dwell=3 s (10τ). Run 6 has |R|≤131 Ω through 6 T; allow a deliberately conservative 10× low-density/MR envelope (~1.31 kΩ), still below the 1.8 kΩ rail checkpoint. This envelope is empirical rather than a guaranteed bound, so monitor every row. Gates span TG 0.8690–0.9836 V and BG 1.0180–1.1663 V; Si stays 0 V. Initial 0→1 T positioning costs 7.3 min; total 0→6 T costs 43.8 min at 0.137 T/min. Run 5 measured ~0.10 s read overhead at NPLC=1; budget 3.20 s/point including paired gates and added vaporizer read, plus ~0.32 s gate flyback, 3 s magnet settle and 1 s slow delay per row. Total ≈3.16 h, priced with 10% margin. Actual first rows will update it. No pacing, validator, or operating-limit changes.

**Checkpoints and endpoint.** Preconditions print expected/actual validators, temperature freshness/base state, heater ranges, Si/output state, magnet state, contact map, drive, settling and gate pacing before writes. Inspect the first three completed rows for rails, leakage, drain continuity, noise and phase; continue only if clean. Recheck every 30 min, and after reaching 3 T compare n=3.2 with run 6, allowing only the expected sensitivity/grid change; abandon if the fan loses the spot-check structure. All recorded channels are plotted. Per-point guards stop on >1 nA gate current, approaching sr1 rail, lost base T, or drain discontinuity; log freshness and actual field are checked per row. If interrupted, hold and read actual state before any next move; a kernel interrupt does not stop an in-progress VTI supply ramp (rig-card rule). On success hold B=6 T and the last gate point for analysis. Re-form the raw map first, then FFT/window stability, harmonic/Luttinger tests, and both ABAB/trilayer overlays before any B_1–B_2 region verdict.
